surface.basis: Pirelli 2025 Belgian GP preview: asphalt grip 3/5, asphalt abrasion 3/5. Other ratings, not used here: traction 4, braking 4, lateral 5, tyre stress 5, track evolution 3, downforce 2.

source.notes: Projected, 13 m wide, scaled to 7,004 m, the line on the climb from the Bus Stop to La Source. Heights: SRTM 30 m (public domain) through Open Topo Data, sampled every 20 m along be-1925 from bacinger/f1-circuits, lined up by curvature and smoothed over about 200 m, scaled to the published 102.2 m highest to lowest, its steepest stretch drawn to the published 17%.
